newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's DBSA raises 700 mln rand on bond market.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's DBSA raises 700 mln rand on bond market.

text.p: The Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA) said it had raised 700 million rand on the local capital market on Monday by issuing stock in its DV07 and DV06 loans.
The funds would be utilised for a variety of infrastructure projects such as water and sanitation, road and drainage, energy and social infrastructure.
The funds were raised through private placement by broking firm Barnard, Jacobs, Mellet Inc.
"The DBSA estimates that the present value of benefits directly associated with this investment will exceed 2.5 billion rand over a period of 20 years," it said in a statement.
Potential benefits included awarding 360 million rand's worth of projects to small contractors and the creation of about 18,000 permanent jobs.
"The projects undertaken will significantly impact on the provision of basic services to low income rural and urban communities throughout the country," it said.
A DBSA spokesman said part of the funding would be used for a 684 million rand infrastructural development loan agreement which it would sign with the Durban Metropolitan Council on June 25.
The bank expects to disburse about 1.8 billion rand in the year to March 31 1998.
